maintenance_led.reason: Revenue is recurring payroll, HR and PEO subscription/outsourcing services, not repair, servicing or replacement of installed equipment.

publicly_funded.reason: Customers are private small, midsized and large employers paying for payroll, HR, benefits and PEO services.

serial_acquirer.reason: Grows mainly organically through payroll and HCM sales to employers, with only occasional acquisitions.

mission_critical.reason: Outsourced payroll, tax filing, compliance and HCM are core; switching risks payroll errors, compliance issues and heavy migration effort.
